# PakCalc — Pakistan Tax & Money Calculators

Free calculators for Pakistan, updated for 2026-27:
- Income Tax Calculator: https://pakcalc-one.vercel.app/income-tax-calculator — salaried slabs under Finance Act 2026 (0% to Rs 600k; 1%/11%/20%/25%/29%/32%/35% bands; surcharge abolished)
- PTA Mobile Tax Calculator: https://pakcalc-one.vercel.app/pta-tax-calculator — DIRBS registration tax on passport or CNIC; customs duty Rs 250 + regulatory duty + 18%/25% sales tax + income tax (CNIC only, doubled for non-filers) + handset levy; per SRO 1064(I)/2026
- Zakat Calculator: https://pakcalc-one.vercel.app/zakat-calculator — 2.5% on cash, gold, silver, business assets; nisab = lower of 7.5 tola gold and 52.5 tola silver

All calculations run client-side. Figures are estimates, not official tax advice. Rates verified October 2026.
